findings.summary: Workflow-only Brain maintenance capability is exposed as an unauthenticated public mutation over caller-controlled workspace context.
findings.details: The task requires workflows to compose capabilities with authorization and workflow-only exposure. maintainBrainPage is declared as a public mutation, accepts arbitrary workspaceSlug/context/modelOutput, and the implementation performs no caller, membership, admin, or workspace/context binding check before returning a published revision effect. A caller that can invoke the public Confect mutation can fabricate a context pack for another workspace/page and obtain an autopilot or review revision effect, while Unauthorized/Forbidden remain declared but unreachable. Rework should make the capability boundary internal/workflow-scoped or require an authenticated caller and server-derived workspace/context pack, and add regression tests proving public/memberless/cross-workspace calls are denied.
